title: Design: breadcrumbs start at Pricing, as the design draws them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  4. Click matrix A's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The breadcrumb reads Pricing › Tiers › and tier A's name, as in picture 2.32.

Step 3:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 4:

  • The breadcrumb reads Pricing › Matrices › and matrix A's name, as in picture 3.2, with no Settings crumb before Pricing.
